name: conformance-harness-prisma
//: Runs with the adapter's toolchain and dependencies (node_modules links to the adapter's): npm ci in ../../../prisma first.

scripts.test:v6: npm run generate:v6 && node -e "for (const f of ['prisma/dev-adversarial.db', 'prisma/dev-adversarial.db-journal']) require('fs').rmSync(f, { force: true })" && node node_modules/prisma-v6/build/index.js db push --skip-generate --schema=prisma/schema.adversarial.v6.prisma && PRISMA_VERSION=6 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
scripts.test:v7: npm run generate:v7 && node -e "for (const f of ['prisma/dev-adversarial.db', 'prisma/dev-adversarial.db-journal']) require('fs').rmSync(f, { force: true })" && node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema=prisma/schema.adversarial.prisma --url=file:./prisma/dev-adversarial.db && PRISMA_VERSION=7 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
scripts.test:postgres:v6: npm run generate:v6 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=postgres PRISMA_VERSION=6 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
scripts.test:postgres:v7: npm run generate:v7 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=postgres PRISMA_VERSION=7 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
scripts.test:mysql:v6: npm run generate:v6 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=mysql PRISMA_VERSION=6 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
scripts.test:mysql:v7: npm run generate:v7 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=mysql PRISMA_VERSION=7 ../../../prisma/node_modules/.bin/jest -c jest.config.js
